title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Return completed A2A replies to the initiating agent
review_findings: Independent bounded review initially found operator-dependent continuation, provider-path mismatch, sequencing, attribution, and size-bound defects. Each was corrected. Final review reported no actionable findings.
review_dispositions: Continuation now runs automatically through the same provider-conversation path, retains raw peer output only as initiated_reply, reports typed continuation failure, holds the parent gate through completion, and bounds continuation context.
review_notes: Focused review covered Runtime A2A close-loop correctness, provider parity with ordinary turns, causal sequencing, result attribution, and bounded context.
